verdict.line: You lose if you let Sion poke you down with Q stuns before you commit E; you win if you force Test of Spirit trades on your terms.

brief.thesis: Sion has no sustained wave-clear pressure and his entire kill threat is landing Q (Cryptic Gaze) to stun you into a follow-up trade; outside that stun he's just a melee auto-attacker who gets weaker relative to you every time he spends health on E (Enrage). Illaoi's E (Test of Spirit) punishes exactly that pattern by forcing him to either tank a huge echo or run, and the 55.7% head-to-head over 70 games confirms the trade math favors you once you play around the stun.

theirWindow.when: Q off cooldown and he's walking up
theirWindow.what: He is hunting a stun to chain into E (Enrage) autos. Keep a minion between you and him or back off until you see Q whiff or go on cooldown (12/11/10/9/8s) before you step up.

yourWindow.when: His Q is down or just missed
yourWindow.what: Walk in and land E (Test of Spirit) immediately — he has no stun to punish the follow-up, and the spirit echo plus your W (Harsh Lesson) leap into tentacle swings wins the all-in outright.

start.why: 66.3% pick rate and 57.4% win rate over 61 games — the extra AD and sustain let you win early trades against his auto-reliant kit without needing the shield from Doran's Shield.

boots.why: 52.9% pick, 52.2% win rate — Sion's damage is almost entirely from autos (E's Enrage) and his Q stun setup, so the flat auto-attack reduction directly cuts his trade damage.

core.why: Core in 2 of the 3 top build paths (13% and 5.8% pick) — the armor shred compounds with your tentacle and W/E burst to shorten trades before he can Enrage-stack.
Paired with Black Cleaver in the top path (55.6% win over 9 games) — the slow on proc keeps him in tentacle range so he can't just walk his Enrage autos away.
Appears in both top paths (13% and 5.8% pick) — the health and tenacity let you survive his all-in window if his Q actually connects.

you're ahead and want to no-sell his burst windows while still punishing with DoT

runes.keystoneWhy: 57.1% overall pick rate and the higher-performing of the two listed pages — Grasp rewards the sustained melee trading pattern this matchup is built on, healing you back up between Q cooldown windows while he burns health on Enrage.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport is run in 67.7% of games at 52.3% win — Teleport lets you reset back after proactive E trades or shove with tentacles, and Flash covers the one real threat, his Q stun engage.

playing.title: Bait the Q before committing
playing.detail: Stand just outside 550 range and watch for Sion to use Q (Cryptic Gaze). Per OP.GG's own read, when he closes in to Q after landing E stacks, sidestep by using W (Harsh Lesson) on a nearby minion instead of eating the stun.

playing.title: E him the moment Q is down
playing.detail: Test of Spirit (16/15/14/13/12s cooldown) has no counterplay once his stun is spent — walk up and rip his spirit immediately, forcing either a bad trade or a vessel.

playing.title: Track his Enrage health loss
playing.detail: E (Enrage) has no cooldown but costs him health per attack — the longer a fight goes, the lower his effective HP pool gets relative to yours, so dragging trades out favors you.

playing.title: Use W to close engages, not just finish
playing.detail: Harsh Lesson (400 range, 4s cooldown) leaps you to him and pulls nearby tentacles onto the target — use it as your gap closer into E, not just as a reset tool.

playing.title: Smash Q on cooldown for free damage
playing.detail: Tentacle Smash (10/9/8/7/6s cooldown, 850 range) should be on cooldown constantly pre-fight; it adds tentacle damage and heals you via passive whenever it lands on him.

playing.title: Save ultimate for his all-in, not yours
playing.detail: Leap of Faith (120/95/70/70/70s) spawns a tentacle per champion hit and should come down right as he commits E stacks into you, since that's when the extra sustain and damage matter most.

playing.title: Don't panic at his R
playing.detail: Cannibalism (90s cooldown) only triggers on attacks and needs sustained contact — disengaging briefly denies the lifesteal and attack speed ramp entirely.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and the 55.7% over 70 games head-to-head figure are measured from live OP.GG match data on the current patch; the ability-timing reads, Q-bait technique, and trade-pattern reasoning are this brief's own analysis.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid Sion’s (Q) as much as possible. When Sion closes in to use (Q) after (E) lands, you can avoid it by using [W] on a nearby minion. Use [E] to engage when (Q) is on cooldown
